title: Flow-based Spectral Kernel Learning for Nonstationary Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.30465v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Kernelized attention provides a useful perspective for understanding self-attention as a similarity-based aggregation mechanism, but existing approaches often rely on fixed or stationary kernels, limiting their ability to adapt the similarity structure to complex token interactions. In this paper, we propose flow-based spectral kernel attention (FSKA), a framework for learning expressive nonstationary attention kernels. FSKA formulates kernelized attention through spectral density learning and parameterizes the resulting bivariate spectral density with normalizing flows. This design enables flexible and regularizable kernel learning while remaining compatible with scalable linear-attention computation. We further show that expressive kernel learning enables a simplified attention design with removed query--key projections and fixed orthogonal value projections, resulting in a more parameter-efficient architecture. Controlled experiment

translated_title: 面向非平稳注意力的基于流的谱核学习
translated_abstract: 核化注意力为理解自注意力作为一种基于相似性的聚合机制提供了有用的视角，但现有方法通常依赖于固定或平稳的核，这限制了它们将相似性结构自适应地调整以应对复杂词元交互的能力。在本文中，我们提出了基于流的谱核注意力，这是一个用于学习富有表现力的非平稳注意力核的框架。FSKA 通过谱密度学习来构建核化注意力，并使用归一化流对所得的二元谱密度进行参数化。这种设计实现了灵活且可正则化的核学习，同时保持与可扩展的线性注意力计算的兼容性。我们进一步证明，富有表现力的核学习使得一种简化的注意力设计成为可能，即移除查询-键投影并使用固定的正交值投影，从而得到参数效率更高的架构。
tldr: 提出基于流的谱核注意力（FSKA），利用归一化流参数化非平稳的二元谱密度来学习灵活且可正则化的注意力核，同时支持移除查询-键投影的简化设计，实现参数效率更高的线性注意力架构。
en_tdlr: Proposes Flow-based Spectral Kernel Attention (FSKA), which learns expressive nonstationary attention kernels by parameterizing bivariate spectral density with normalizing flows, enabling a simplified and parameter-efficient linear attention architecture with removed query-key projections.
